title: ONE SWEETLY SOLEMN THOUGHT
stanzas: One sweetly solemn thought Comes to me o'er and o'er; Nearer my home today am I Than e'er I've been before.
Nearer my Father's house, Where many mansions be, Nearer today, the great white throne, Nearer the crystal sea.
Nearer the bound of life, Where burdens are laid down; Nearer to leave the heavy cross, Nearer to gain the crown.
But lying darkly between, Windows down through the night, Is the deep and unknown stream To be crossed ere we reach the light
Father, perfect my trust! Strengthen my pow'r of faith! Nor let me stand, at last, alone Upon the shore of death.
Be Thee near when my feet Are slipping over the brink, For it may I'm nearer home, Nearer now than I think.
chorus: Nearer my home, Nearer my home, Nearer my home today, today,Than e'er I've been before.
